analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has entered oversold territory, and ADX trend weakening persists. The current price of 79,005 KRW is high relative to the 52-week low of 30,840 KRW, but remains below the SMA200 by -21.84%, indicating a continued downtrend. With five consecutive daily candles appearing negative, a cautious approach is warranted until confirmation of buying pressure.

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Buy score of 4 due to RSI entering oversold territory and ADX trend weakening; maintaining a wait-and-see approach until buying pressure is confirmed.
